title: [finding] The "strip pm:* on close" convention is systematically unfollowed — ≥100 closed cards per lane per label still carry pm state, across at least three lanes, back to 2026-08-05
body:
Filed by the `domain:devx` PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`, from a **manual half-state sweep** run because `check:half-states` cannot run in this container. ⛔ **Ungraded and unrouted** — `domain:*`, priority and type are triage's. Filed **unassigned**.

## Measured, 2026-08-30

The protocol states: **关闭即摘 `pm:*` 状态标**(与关单同一笔). Measured against closed issues:

| query | result |
|---|---:|
| closed + `domain:devx` + `pm:dispatched` | **≥100** (page cap) |
| closed + `domain:devx` + `pm:queue` | **≥100** (page cap) |
| closed + `domain:devx` + `pm:blocked` | 5 |
| closed + `domain:devx` + `pm:on-hold` | 2 |
| closed + `domain:spec` + `pm:dispatched` | **≥100** (page cap) |
| closed + `domain:engine` + `pm:dispatched` | **≥100** (page cap) |

⚠️ **Every "≥100" is a page cap, not a count.** ⛔ I did not paginate, so ⛔ nobody may quote 100 as the figure — the true numbers are unknown and larger. ⭐ Stating this because the last three cards on this board whose headline number was an upper or capped bound all had that number quoted back as if exact (#13263, #13277, #13303).

**Control:** the same query shape with only `domain:devx` + `state=closed` returns rows ⇒ the instrument works and the non-zeros are readings.

**Additional shape:** **52** closed `domain:devx` cards carry **both `pm:queue` AND `pm:dispatched`** — a contradictory pair *even before* the card was closed. Oldest observed: **#5559, closed 2026-08-05T22:39:17Z**.

⇒ this is not a residue from one round or one seat. It is **cross-lane and roughly as old as the label scheme**.

## ⛔ What is NOT claimed — the harm model, stated precisely

- ⛔ **This does NOT cause mis-dispatch.** Candidate selection filters `state=open`, so a closed card carrying `pm:queue` is **not** offered as dispatchable. ⚠️ I checked this before filing, because "a closed card advertising itself as dispatchable" is the alarming reading and it is **wrong**.
- What it does cost:
  1. **`check:half-states` is the gate that exists to catch exactly this** — and it exits 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` in an agent container, so the population it guards has been growing unobserved. ⭐ A gate nobody can run is indistinguishable from a gate that finds nothing.
  2. **The labels misdescribe history.** A closed card that reads `pm:dispatched` claims work is in flight on it.
  3. **Protocol health readings assume honest labels** — e.g. "裸 `finding` 数即健康读数". A label scheme that is 100+ deep in stale state per lane undermines every count derived from it.
- ⛔ Not asserted that any specific decision was made on a stale label.
- ⛔ Not asserted the convention is wrong. It looks correct and simply is not being executed.

## ⛔ Why this seat did not just fix it

A bulk relabel of hundreds of closed cards across **three or more lanes** is ⛔ not a lane seat's unilateral act: most of these cards belong to other seats and other rounds, and a whole-set label PUT **silently strips concurrent labels** (the standing hazard this board already records). ⇒ recorded rather than swept.

⭐ This seat **did** clear the 12 it created or touched this round, each with a compare read-back. That is the scope a lane seat owns.

## Re-check

```
# per lane, per label — and PAGINATE, which this filing did not
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues?labels=pm:dispatched,domain:devx&state=closed&per_page=100&page=N"
```

⚠️ Filter out pull requests — the `issues` endpoint returns both. ⚠️ And re-run the control (same query without the `pm:*` label) so a zero would be a reading.

## Refs

- `check:half-states` — the gate for this class; exits 3 in an agent container
- **#13112** — a live card that carried `pm:queue` while assigned with an open PR (the open-card version of this shape, which **is** dangerous)
